Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs aliased as compound_chembl_id and canonical SMILES aliased as canonical_smiles for compounds tested against target CHEMBL5162 (neuropeptide S receptor) in human assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno (INNER JOIN). Filter target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5162' and assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Deduplicate on compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id ascending.
